tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: Find published Secret Store pages by group or a case-insensitive substring of the title or summary. Returns each page's URL, title, summary and last update, plus a direct Markdown URL for documentation pages.

tools.name: get_install_commands
tools.description: Return copyable setup commands for a selected client or operating system. Omit target to list every command, including CLI installers and the commands for registering the vault server in an MCP client.

tools.name: get_mcp_connection
tools.description: Read the vault MCP integration metadata for a custom client or OAuth setup. Returns the Streamable HTTP endpoint, server card, tool catalog, authorization metadata, scopes and tool names.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_pages" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
